source.heading: T001 — Pre-request validation for equal_priority_window and reconciliation_appstore_search_exception
source.pattern: Follow the existing `_validate_settings` style in tools/reconciliation_tools.py (return an 'Error: ...' string, never raise). Mirror the semantics of dash-api's `ValidateEqualPriorityWindowValue` (Kochava/dash-api internal/utils/helpers/equal_priority.go): trim whitespace, exact decimal comparison for -1/0/24, float comparison for the 1/60 lower bound. See A3.

interfaces.consumes: Existing `_validate_settings(settings: dict[str, str]) -> str | None` in tools/reconciliation_tools.py (returns an 'Error: ...' string or None). Today any key outside `_ENUM_SETTING_VALID_TOKENS` falls into the numeric lookback branch, which rejects negatives, so equal_priority_window='-1' is wrongly rejected and reconciliation_appstore_search_exception is only checked as a non-negative number. Also consumes the existing `kochava_set_attribution_windows` tool body, whose generic all-strings check (`not all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) ...)`) precedes `_validate_settings`. Anchors: see A3.
interfaces.produces:
```python
_EQUAL_PRIORITY_WINDOW_KEY = "equal_priority_window"
_APPSTORE_SEARCH_EXCEPTION_KEY = "reconciliation_appstore_search_exception"
def _validate_equal_priority_window(value: object) -> str | None  # error string naming valid values, or None
def _validate_appstore_search_exception(value: object) -> str | None
```
